positions.title: Hybrid Mobile Developer
positions.description:
• Developed mobile applications using Android Framework Services like Intent, Services, AIDL and common android framework API’s (location, camera, Notification, Maps, content provider, Google maps, Wi-fi and Bluetooth).
• Used components like Fragments, Activity workflow, ActionBar Navigation, Recycler View, List View, Scroll View and Grid View for building application.
• Extensively utilized Retrofit Library with OKHttp for API calls and parsed JSON data.
• Integrated android libraries such as Butter Knife, Volley, Dagger for dependency injection and loose coupling.
• Performed version control and configuration management using GitHub.
• Focused on implementing rich user interface per UI/UX and Google’s Material Design specifications.
• Used JIRA as a project tracking tool, Jenkins to build application. ADB as command line tool for installing apk.

positions.description:
• Developed a tourist web application as well as a mobile application which lists down all the information relating to a place.
• Integrated maps and weather API in the application.

projects.title: Drone Infrastructure as a Service
projects.description:
• Developed an android application for end user and service provider to facilitate on demand drone service.
• Fetched data from REST API and displayed on admin dashboard.
• Implemented the socket listener and socket emitter for communicating a data.

projects.title: GoGreen
projects.description:
• Developed a cloud based mobile application that provides a platform for delivering nearby energy efficient services to the end user.
• Also developed admin dashboard for managing all the services of the app.
• Technologies- Android, Heroku, REST, MongoDB
